content.title: Snowboard Route Escalation | Equipment Check, Turns, Aerial, Landing
content.summary: A rescue instructor completes a marked glacier route and one bounded aerial. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult rider, equipment set and route remain continuous. + A visible equipment check precedes locomotion. + Route difficulty increases through traceable turns rather than cuts. + The aerial follows established acceleration and remains physically bounded. + The terminal view proves landing and reconnects the complete route geography.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one adult rescue-board instructor with a rust jacket, white helmet and teal board at the top of a marked glacier lane. Follow three alternating edge turns around fixed blue markers without changing her identity or route direction. Hold the landing, then crane high to reconnect the complete instructor, marker line and original glacier basin.
